text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Right now, I am offering 
detailed explanations regarding the 
upcoming "Ramen Jamboree" to anyone 
interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: <username>, do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of things we should ask about 
training for the "Ramen Jamboree"――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'd like to know about the "Ramen 
Jamboree," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Ramen Jamboree... also known as RMJ! 
To express our gratitude to everyone 
helping host races across the country and 
cheering to make them a success—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's an event where Umamusume make and 
serve ramen!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To ensure the success of the event held in 
late December every year, all of you will 
participate in tasting sessions alongside 
your daily training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Conducting Tasting Sessions earns you 
"Hype Pts," which contribute to the 
event's success! Make sure to hold plenty 
of tastings in each period!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, while participating in the 
Twinkle Series, you will also be hosting 
the Ramen Jamboree.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training 
conditions, your training may conclude 
even during the prep period for Ramen 
Jamboree.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
the "Ramen Jamboree." Is there anything 
else you'd like to ask about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Region Selection".

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Leading up to the Ramen Jamboree held at 
the end of each year, you'll select a 
region to focus your ramen research on!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can select up to 3 regions per period! 
Once selected, you cannot change them 
until the event begins, so please be 
careful, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are 10 regions in total to choose 
from! However, the available regions 
change depending on the time of year, so 
plan your selections carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, depending on your choice, the ramen 
you can make during Tasting Events will 
differ. Evaluate their effects and choose 
a region that aligns with your training 
plan!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, the base amount of Mastery 
Gauge gained each turn will change 
depending on the 3 regions you choose.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This directly affects the 'Ramen Knacks' 
needed to make ramen, so don't forget to 
check on that!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of "Region 
Selection." Is there anything else you 
would like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'd like to know about "Ramen Tips," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To make ramen during a Tasting Session, 
you'll need "Ramen Tips"! A combination of 
3 different types is required.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
While carrying out training and races, the 
Umamusume earn Mastery Gauge points by 
studying ramen from their chosen region.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And when the Mastery Gauge fills up, 
you'll earn hints for that ramen!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can hold up to 10 tips across all 3 
types! Any gained beyond that will 
disappear starting from the oldest, so 
make sure to hold tasting sessions at 
regular intervals!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, any Ramen Tips in your 
possession will reset once the Ramen 
Jamboree begins.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
After the event, you will need to acquire 
new ramen tips, so be careful not to hold 
back too much!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, during training, you can 
acquire the 'Secret Ingredient Tips,' 
which differ from regular ramen tips!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This will not be reset, but please note 
that it cannot be acquired via the 
learning gauge, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
"Ramen Tips." Is there anything else you'd 
like to ask about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You mean about the "tasting session," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In the Tasting Sessions, you'll combine 
Ramen Tips to cook ramen from your chosen 
region, hone your skills, and prepare for 
the Ramen Jamboree!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can hold a Tasting Session anytime as 
long as you have the Ramen Tips for your 
chosen region, and doing so will not 
consume a turn.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, you can only do this once per 
turn, so please keep that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Even if you lack Ramen Knacks, you can 
substitute the missing ones with 'Secret 
Ingredient Tips' to hold tasting events.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can only use up to two secret 
seasoning tricks per tasting session, so 
choose your timing wisely!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Holding a Tasting Session earns you Hype 
Pts and triggers regional effects, such as 
boosting training and granting skill 
hints.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, as you earn Excitement Pts, some of 
the effects gained from the Tasting Events 
will also increase!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Efficiently gather ramen tips, hold 
tasting sessions, and execute even more 
powerful training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation regarding 
the 'tasting session.' Do you have any 
other questions?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a 
brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any 
time by tapping the 'i' button in the top 
left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck. I'll be cheering 
you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best, 
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
